description: Vietnamese Unicode characters exceed BYTE length semantics

expectedDiagnostics.messageContains: Byte overflow risk: property 'FullName' may exceed column 'FULL_NAME' byte capacity in BYTE semantics

notes: Vietnamese characters like 'Đ', 'ă', 'ê', 'ô', 'ư' use 2-3 bytes in UTF-8. 'Nguyễn Văn Tèo' (14 chars) = ~28 bytes, exceeds 50 BYTE limit if longer names are used.
